text:
amar: Heads up — HPA for inference-prod just pushed 10 replicas at 12:04 and they’re stuck Pending. CA doesn't seem to be provisioning GPU nodes.

infra-bot: [cluster-autoscaler] scale-up request denied for nodepool "gpu-pool-eu-west": max size reached (20). req 10 -> would exceed max.

rachel: Is gpu-pool at max? We have reserved dedicated capacity for some tenants but it shouldn't block autoscale for the shared pool.

simon: Quick check — these pods have nodeSelector: gpu=true and tolerations only for "gpu:NoSchedule". Also I see a taint applied yesterday on gpu-pool-preemptible: `preemptible=true:NoSchedule`.

kai: Also VPA updated pod requests earlier which increased scheduling footprint — could be HPA+VPA feedback loop. HPA spins up, VPA inflates requests, pods go Pending, CA sees no room.

ops-oncall: Doing `kubectl describe pod` now, pasting events:
```
Events:
  Type     Reason            Age   From               Message
  ----     ------            ----  ----               -------
  Warning  FailedScheduling  2m    default-scheduler  0/20 nodes are available: 20 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu
  Normal   NotTriggerScaleUp 1m    cluster-autoscaler  pod didn't trigger scale-up (max size reached or ignored)
```

infra-bot: [CA] recent activity: attempts to provision nodes in gpu-pool-eu-west denied because max nodepool size == 20 and there's also a soft quota for GPUs in eu-west region at account level.

lucy: If eu-west is at regional quota, CA can't create new nodes even if we increase nodepool max. We might need to request quota bump or move workloads to another pool.

rachel: Short term: reduce HPA maxReplicas to limit chase. Long term: HPA should consider backend queue length + pod readiness to avoid overshoot during provisioning lag.

simon: Agreed. I'll open an RFC to change the HPA metric to 'average queued request latency' + integrate a 'provisioning grace' metric that stalls scale beyond current pending capacity.

amar: I'll patch HPA: set maxReplicas 8 -> and add stabilizationWindowSeconds 300. Also setting `behavior.scaleUp.policy` to prefer smaller steps.

ops-oncall: Alert rule created: Pending GPU pod > 2m -> notify #eng-infra and escalate to oncall. Patch deployed.

kai: Reverted the VPA minAllowed bump (it had set cpu min to 1G) — that should reduce request sizes and help bin-packing.

infra-bot: [deploy-bot] rollout: HPA config updated by amar — maxReplicas 8, stabilization 300s. CA: also triggered scale-out of non-preemptible gpu-pool by +2 nodes (quota ok).

ops-oncall: Pods are scheduling on the new nodes, replica set converged, CPU and latency back to normal. Will monitor for 30m :thumbsup:
